Name: Happy Tails
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
[b][color=#ea9999][size=6]Happy Tails[/size][/color][/b]
[heading]Give your furry companions the love and care they deserve.[/heading]
[b]Happy Tails expands Stardew Valley's pet system with meaningful daily interactions, turning cats and dogs into companions that grow alongside your farm. Feed them every morning, strengthen your friendship, unlock unique personalities, and record your journey together in a scrapbook filled with memories.[/b]

[b][size=6][color=#ea9999]Features[/color][/size][/b]
[heading][color=#fce5cd]Personal Food Bowls[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Separate bowls for cats and dogs. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Every bowl belongs to a specific pet. [/b][/*]
[/list][heading][color=#fff2cc]Wet & Dry Food[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Feed pets species-specific wet and dry food. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Wet food provides a larger friendship bonus than dry food. [/b][/*]
[/list][heading][color=#fce5cd]Daily Feeding Routine[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Pets walk to their assigned bowl every morning. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Bowls become empty after meals. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Feeding becomes a natural part of your daily farm routine. [/b][/*]
[/list][b][color=#fce5cd][size=4]Friendship Progression[/size][/color]
[color=#e4e4e7][size=3]Build stronger bonds by caring for your companions through regular meals and treats.[/size][/color][/b]

[color=#fce5cd][size=4][b]Treat System[/b][/size][/color]
[b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Reward your companions with delicious treats. As your friendship grows, special Golden Treats become available through gameplay.[/size][/color][/b]

[color=#fce5cd][size=4][b]Pers[/b][/size][/color][color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]onality Bloom[/size][/b][/color]
[b]As your bond grows, your companion develops a unique personality, making every pet feel truly one of a kind.[/b]

[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Unique Talents[/size][/b][/color]
[b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Every companion eventually unlocks a unique talent that reflects the friendship you've built together.[/size][/color][/b]

[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Scrapbook[/size][/b][/color]
[b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Track your companion's journey, including:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Meals eaten [/b][/*]
[*][b]Friendship progress [/b][/*]
[*][b]Personality [/b][/*]
[*][b]Talents [/b][/*]
[*][b]Memories [/b][/*]
[/list]
[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Special Rewards[/size][/b][/color]
[b]After your first Personality Bloom, Marnie recognizes your dedication and begins selling special Golden Treats.[/b]

[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Purchasing a Bowl[/size][/b][/color]
[b]Visit Marnie's Ranch and purchase the appropriate bowl for your companion.[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Cat Food Bowl [/b][/*]
[*][b]Dog Food Bowl [/b][/*]
[/list]
[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Placing the Bowl[/size][/b][/color]
[b]Place the bowl anywhere on your farm where your pet can easily reach it.[/b]

[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Assigning a Pet[/size][/b][/color]
[b]Interact with the bowl and choose which companion it belongs to. Each bowl can only be assigned to one pet at a time.[/b]

[color=#fce5cd][size=4][b]Filling the Bowl[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Hold the correct food and interact with the bowl to fill it.[/b]
[b]Cats can only eat cat food, while dogs can only eat dog food.[/b]

[color=#fce5cd][b][size=4]Daily Feeding[/size][/b][/color]
[b]At 7:00 AM each morning, pets automatically walk to their assigned bowl, eat their meal, and increase their friendship with you.[/b]
[line]
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=6]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install the latest version of SMAPI. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Download Happy Tails. [/b][/*]
[*][b]Extract the HappyTails folder into: [/b][/*]
[/list]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[list=1]
[*][b]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=6]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later [/b][/*]
[*][b]Latest version of SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b][color=#f4cccc][size=5]Android Users[/size][/color][/b]
If you're playing Stardew Valley on Android, install the[color=#ffff00] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29884]Virtual Keyboard[/url][/color] mod to access keyboard controls.By default:[/*]
[*][list]
[*][b]Press X while holding pet food to fill an assigned bowl.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Press X [/b][b]while holding a treat to give it to your pet.[/b][/*]
[/list]This allows Android players to use all Happy Tails interactions just like PC players.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=6]Bug Reports[/size][/color][/b]
[b]If you encounter an issue, please include:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]A description of the problem [/b][/*]
[*][b]Steps to reproduce it [/b][/*]
[*][b]Your SMAPI log [/b][/*]
[/list][b]This helps identify and resolve issues more quickly.[/b]
[line]
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=6]Permissions[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Please see the included LICENSE.txt for the full license and usage permissions.[/b]
[line]
[b][color=#fce5cd][size=6]Credits[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Created by Owljoy[/b]
[b]Thank you for downloading Happy Tails. I hope it makes every cat and dog on your farm feel like a true member of the family.[/b]
